title: TD3: twin critics, delayed actors and smoothing

chapters.text: Compare two action-value curves. Minimum estimate: -1.8; Two-point smoothed illustration: -1.68.

Average two nearby target actions. Minimum estimate: 0.75; Two-point smoothed illustration: 0.744.
